LandingPage.faq_1_q: How do I start a course?
LandingPage.faq_1_a: Create a student account, choose a Foundation or Specialization program, and enroll. Once enrolled, you can immediately access the learning modules.
LandingPage.faq_2_a: Yes. Every certificate has a unique ID and QR code that links to the official verification page, allowing anyone to verify its authenticity.
LandingPage.faq_3_a: No. The Foundation Level is designed for beginners. You only need a browser and motivation to learn.
LandingPage.faq_4_a: Foundation (CBEc) covers the basics of Blue Economy complete with exams and field study. Specialization offers 10 in-depth tracks, such as Blue Carbon, Blue Finance, and Blue Energy.
LandingPage.faq_5_a: Yes. Submit a motivation letter from the student dashboard; the admin will decide if you receive Fully Funded, Partial, or no scholarship.

VerifyPage.title: Validate Authenticity of Blue Economy Certificates
VerifyPage.desc: Instantly authenticate official credentials from The Blue Economist International and Maritim Muda Nusantara through an accredited registry.
VerifyPage.search_guidance: Enter the official serial number printed on your physical or PDF certificate to view graduation details.
VerifyPage.unsearched_desc: Use the search bar above to transparently validate the authenticity of graduation certificates from The Blue Economist International and Maritim Muda Nusantara in real-time.
VerifyPage.unsearched_item1_desc: Printed on the lower portion of your physical certificate or official PDF.
VerifyPage.unsearched_item2_desc: Direct verification against the international consortium digital registry.
VerifyPage.unsearched_item3_desc: Smartphone cameras can directly scan the QR code on the document for instant verification.
VerifyPage.invalid_tip1: • Double-check the serial number entered (ensure there are no typo errors in letters or numbers).
VerifyPage.invalid_tip2: • If the certificate was issued within the last 24 hours, data synchronization may still be propagating.
VerifyPage.invalid_tip3: • Contact our help center if your serial number is officially printed on a certificate but not yet recognized.
VerifyPage.cert_certifies: This certifies that the academic competence and credential in the name of:
VerifyPage.cert_completed: Has fulfilled all international curriculum requirements and passed the official graduation competency examination:
VerifyPage.cert_verified_note: Credential verified directly from official consortium servers
VerifyPage.pillar_title: How We Protect Your Certification Integrity
VerifyPage.p1_desc: Each certificate features a tiered tamper-proof unique identifier permanently recorded in the maritime registry.
VerifyPage.p2_desc: Recognized by The Blue Economist International Association and blue economy stakeholders across 30+ countries.
VerifyPage.p3_desc: Enables industry recruiters, universities, and maritime agencies to verify candidate qualifications in seconds.
VerifyPage.faq_title: Frequently Asked Questions on Certificate Validation
VerifyPage.faq_desc: Comprehensive guide on validating documents and resolving credential lookup issues.
VerifyPage.bottom_cta_title: Not Yet Certified in Blue Economy?
VerifyPage.bottom_cta_desc: Upgrade your professional qualifications today. Join the official Certified Blue Economist (CBEc) training programs alongside global ocean experts.
VerifyPage.qr_modal_desc: Direct validation guide using official certificate QR code
VerifyPage.qr_step1: Open the Camera or QR reader app on your smartphone.
VerifyPage.qr_step2: Point the camera lens at the QR code printed on the physical or PDF certificate.
VerifyPage.qr_step3: Tap the notification link to directly open this official validity verification page.

AboutPage.title: Building the Global Maritime Fulcrum through Ocean Sustainability
AboutPage.desc: DigiBlue was established to bridge the skills gap between maritime potential and global industry needs through internationally accredited blue economy training and certification.
AboutPage.roadmap_title: 4 Core Pillars of DigiBlue Curriculum Development
AboutPage.roadmap_desc: Each training module and syllabus is designed in harmony with scientific conservation principles and commercial viability.
AboutPage.board_desc: Curriculum materials are evaluated periodically by maritime advisory councils to ensure relevance to current ocean industries.
AboutPage.cta_title: Start Your Journey as a Blue Economy Expert
AboutPage.cta_desc: Earn industry-recognized credentials and join the future maritime professional network.
AboutPage.p1_desc: Protecting marine biodiversity, mitigating the impacts of overfishing, and promoting science-based coral reef conservation.
AboutPage.p2_desc: Optimizing mangrove and seagrass ecosystems as global carbon sinks through innovative green financing mechanisms (Green/Blue Bonds).
AboutPage.p3_desc: Supporting IMO initiatives for low-emission fuel transition across shipping fleets and electrification of integrated port logistics.
AboutPage.p4_desc: Enhancing the welfare of traditional fishermen, seaweed cultivators, and coastal enterprises through digital technology.
AboutPage.ent1_desc: International non-profit professional body formulating competence taxonomy, certification standards, and Certified Blue Economist (CBEc) curricula.
AboutPage.ent2_desc: Official maritime youth organization consolidating thousands of scholars, young researchers, and maritime economy drivers nationwide.
AboutPage.ent3_desc: Strategic research institute under STIE Indonesia Jakarta integrating micro-macro economic analysis with real maritime industry policy implementation.
